name: Keep Has All HAPI Inputs
remarks: Keep module for the Synthea -k flag. NOT a regular module — do not load it via -d.
Third step of an incremental keep module (see keep_has_labs.json for the prior step).
Requires all three groups below to be present:
1. Labs (strict AND — all four required, matches keep_has_labs.json):
albumin (LOINC 1751-7), BUN (LOINC 3094-0), chloride (LOINC 2075-0), RDW-CV (LOINC 788-0).
2. Nursing assessments (soft OR — at least one of six, since hapi_braden_assessments.json
only fires for patients with a qualifying acute-care/risk condition, unlike the labs):
braden_mobility (LOINC 38224-2), braden_moisture (LOINC 38229-1), braden_activity (LOINC 38223-4),
braden_friction (LOINC 38226-7), braden_sensory (LOINC 38222-6), gait_transfer (LOINC 93015-6).
3. Device/condition/medication resources (soft OR — at least one of eleven; requiring ALL would be
impossible, since e.g. ECMO needs septic shock while ostomy is an unrelated 5% random event):
has_edema (SNOMED 79654002), has_spinal_cord_injury (SNOMED 90584004 or built-in 1734006),
is_icu_admitted (SNOMED 309904001), is_on_gim_service (local code gim-service),
is_on_vasopressin (RxNorm 11149), is_on_cardio_sympathomimetic (RxNorm 3628/7512/3992/8163),
has_central_line/has_chest_tube/is_on_ecmo/has_ostomy/has_tracheostomy (Procedure, detected via
assign_to_attribute on those states — Synthea has no 'Active Procedure' logic condition and
PriorState only sees the calling module's own history, so Procedures from other modules are
only detectable this way).
Set --exporter.years_of_history >= (max_age - min_age) — Observation entries (labs, Braden/gait,
gim-service) have no 'still active' export exemption, unlike Condition/Medication entries.
All codes validated against tx.fhir.org on 2026-09-04.
